messages:
Alice: FYI — Helios Labs (enterprise) has 2 invoices on hold because VAT / resale cert name mismatch. Need billing help to unblock reverse-charge.

BillingBot: Case created CS-23048. A billing specialist will review.

Tom: Can you drop repro + the last 4 of the VAT ID & country? I'll need the uploaded docs link to verify.

Alice: Repro steps:
1) Customer uploaded two PDFs to billing portal.
2) Our VIES check (API) returned valid:true but name = "Helios Labs GmbH".
3) OCR/filename shows "Helios Labs Germany GmbH" -> normalization mismatch triggers automatic hold.
4) Affected invoices: INV-2025-0087, INV-2025-0088.

VIES response (copied):
```
{"countryCode":"DE","vatNumber":"DE123456789","valid":true,"name":"Helios Labs GmbH","address":"Berliner Str. 8, 10115 Berlin"}
```

Alice: Upload link: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/cases/CS-23048/helios_docs.zip (shared with billing).

Marta: Quick legal note — if VIES validates the VAT ID but the uploaded name doesn't exactly match, we can accept a manual override only when the document is a government extract or national business register entry that explicitly lists the VAT number. Also request a PO or contract to tie the purchase to the legal entity.

Jules: How-to for manual override (console + internal API):
- Console -> Billing -> Invoices -> Select invoice -> Actions -> Mark as VAT-exempt -> attach docs -> justification.
Internal API (ops only):
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/billing/invoices/INV-2025-0087/override \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"exempt":true,"reason":"Manual acceptance - gov extract verified","tags":["reverse_charge","manual_override"]}'
```

Helios Billing: We uploaded national registration extract (helios_reg.pdf) + PO PO-99881. Last 4 of VAT: 6789. Please confirm next steps.

Tom: Got the docs. I'll verify the PDF shows the same VAT id and then apply manual override. Expect this done in ~2h. :thumbsup: 

Alice: Thanks — please paste the audit log entry after you apply so Support can close the case.

Tom: Audit log entry (after override):
```
2025-11-02T14:27:12Z tom_billing override:INV-2025-0087 -> exempt:true reason:"gov extract verified" case:CS-23048
```

Jules: Closing loop — support message sent to customer, invoices unheld, reverse charge applied. Case CS-23048 resolved.

Helios Billing: Thanks team! Confirmed receipts received. :heart:
